description: Workflow route ids, descriptions, and prompt packet kinds read by scripts/mythify_router.py. The selection order lives in select_workflow_route, not in this file.

routes.description: Recover from the latest failed executed verification before starting unrelated work.
Use a bounded outcome loop when the user provides success criteria and a verifier, or an active outcome is already in progress.
Frame product-planning work (problem, primary user, measurable outcomes, non-goals, bets, risks) in a product record and get a human's approval before any bet becomes a plan.
Chart or work a wayfinding decision map when the effort is too big for one session, the route to the destination is not visible yet, or a research-like prompt asks several foggy questions.
Use review or audit workflow when the user asks for findings, risks, critique, or evaluation.
Resume an active plan or current workflow state without assuming hidden chat context, or render steering material on request.
Create a verifiable plan for ordinary multi-step implementation work, including full-send requests.
Answer directly or make a single reversible edit when no durable workflow is needed, including single-question research lookups.
